title: Austin Budget Cuts & Job Layoffs Approved
summary:
*   City officials held an extensive worksession to review and discuss the upcoming operating and capital budget.
*   A significant policy decision was made, approving the layoff of 75 employees from the Transportation and Public Service departments.
*   Several city departments, including Information Systems, Internal Audit, Legal, and the Library, presented their reports during the session.

Council Chambers, 307 West Second Street, Austin, Texas Memorandum To: Mayor Cooksey
called to order the meeting of the Council, noting the absence of Councilmember Urdy. The
Mayor announced the purpose of the meeting was to hold a worksession on the Operating and
Capital Budget.
Departments which gave their reports were Transportation and Public Service, who received
Council approval to lay off 75 people in their department; Information Systems, Internal
Audit, Legal and the Library.
The Mayor announced the worksession would be continued to 2:30p.m. on August 13, 1987.
Council adjourned its meeting at 5:55 p.m.
